articles.title: Tell HN: Meta's AI support feature allows Instagram accounts to be stolen
articles.summary: If the AI support option is enabled for your Instagram account (it appears to be A/B tested for only a percentage of accounts), anyone can hijack it with little effort. Simply get on a proxy or VPN close to the account's region, then ask the agent to send a code to an arbitrary email address.
